entries.description: Wednesday, July 16, 2014 - Governor Patrick surveys the recent construction done to the historic governor’s office chambers in the State House. The renovation project, which began in November 2013, will restore the chambers back to it’s former glory and also broaden public access to it. (Photo: Eric Haynes / Governor’s Office)
